title: Transparency
lead: How the campaign books are kept. Of what has already arrived we publish what share was used; the 100% of the work is not published yet.
method: Gifts are recorded after they are reconciled against the bank statement. Individual amounts and the names of those who gave are not published.
Invoices and receipts for the work are kept in an internal file. They are not published because they often hold third-party data.
On this page money is spoken of as percentages: of what has already arrived, what share was used and what share remains. The 100% of the work is not published, so there is no goal to measure against.
